variety_description: Good yield, medium maturity, medium tall, medium bold variety suitable for cultivation under rainfed lowland conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 2007 for planting in Bangladesh in Aman season. Low GI. Photo sensitive, shattering susceptible. Grain spots
